verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Disputes API for processing disputes and includes sandbox testing support, and its marketing states Square manages the chargeback process on the merchant's behalf. However, evidence lacks detail on submitting structured evidence packages, tracking lifecycle stages, or dashboard UI workflow for finance-ops beyond the API reference titles. missing for 10: documentation of evidence submission format/fields, dispute status/lifecycle tracking details, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the dispute resolution workflow.
